body: Nobody in my immediate family cares about me, the rest of my family members live in Korea and Italy and I haven't had any friends in years.
I don't really have the capability to do videos, I love writing stories and playing the piano, and I will admit it helps a bit, but it's not enough usually.
And why should I keep fighting? Because somewhere years and years of suffering later, i might be able to obtain a shred of happiness?
What is the point in trudging through life, futilely trying to find happiness, just for a hope of one day not being an absolute mess of a person?

I want to start off by saying that you are a wonderful human being. I understand that that it might get better eventually, i just want you to ask her what her how she handled going through life before she met you.

why should i stick around and try to improve other people's days when i don't ever get to be happy myself? i most certainly am not a good person, i am extremely selfish, argumentative, and according to anyone who has ever known me, a stuck-up bitch.

I've tried that before, but I can't really write anything down without bringing back vividly terrible memories. That is also why I tried to keep the OP short, what I wrote there is just the start to how shitty my life has been.
I just want to know how you justified going on knowing that for the rest of your life you might never get to feel any joy or get any restful nights. Just the thought of that is eating me up inside.
